description: Score a fine-tuned Gr00t checkpoint by replaying recorded episodes and reporting the mean squared error between predicted and recorded actions. Runs offline -- no simulator or robot is involved.
inputInstructions: Scores an existing checkpoint on the asset. Leave Checkpoint folder blank to evaluate the most recent gr00tOutput_* folder, which is what an evaluation run straight after a fine-tuning run wants. The dataset evaluated is the one at 'dataset' within the asset -- when that is the dataset the checkpoint trained on, the reported MSE measures fit rather than generalization, and the metrics file records that caveat.

tagSchema.label: Checkpoint folder
tagSchema.description: Name of the gr00tOutput_* folder on the asset to evaluate. Leave blank to use the most recent one.

tagSchema.label: Trajectories to evaluate
tagSchema.description: How many recorded episodes to replay. More trajectories give a steadier metric and take longer.

tagSchema.label: Steps per trajectory
tagSchema.description: How many timesteps of each episode to evaluate.
